value.rationale: Natural family induced by a local Boolean graph-incidence map has a complete all-degree shattered-support classification. More importantly, the sharp infinite sequence n=3q+1 separates static and adaptive dimensions by one through a nontrivial conditional two-tree construction, contrasting the equality phenomenon in the motivating 2021 model-theoretic source. The modulus-three structure is forced by the obstruction, not an arbitrary selection.
